csv_scope_of_work: This project will build on the conceptual design plan that LDP/Melk produced for 4th Street between the Ohio River and Liberty Street in 2024 along with other previous efforts to create a unified design that will strengthen the identity of the corridor by enhancing its aesthetics, improving connectivity to the Ohio River and other destinations along the corridor (including the Kentucky International Convention Center and the Belvedere, an elevated park sitting on top of the Riverfront parking garage and extending over I64), integrating green infrastructure, and creating a safe, attractive, walkable environment.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
